name: Draw centers and fits the page before the first canvas interaction

events.js: (() => { let s=document.getElementById('stage').getBoundingClientRect(); let p=document.getElementById('paper').getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.abs(s.x+s.width/2-p.x-p.width/2)<1.5 && Math.abs(s.y+s.height/2-p.y-p.height/2)<1.5 && p.width<=s.width-46 && p.height<=s.height-46; })()
